executionScenarios.name: notifies-only-new
executionScenarios.description: Only previously-unseen reviews trigger a notification
executionScenarios.dataSetup: On a scheduled run, the Play Store returns two reviews and the App Store returns one review; one of the Play Store reviews was already seen on a prior run (stored state), the other two are new.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow executes without errors and sends notifications only for the two new reviews, not the already-seen one.

conversation.text: I want an automation that sends me a push notification whenever users leave new reviews for my app on the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.
How should I fetch the reviews, and how do you want to be notified?

[Say it should run on a schedule, fetch recent reviews from both stores (via their APIs / HTTP requests), only notify about reviews it hasn't seen before, and send you a push notification (a push service or a messaging channel is fine). If asked for app IDs or credentials, give placeholders and move on.]

description: Sourced from a real Instance AI conversation (thread 650b3080) that built and executed successfully: notifying the user of new app-store reviews. Tests change-detection (notify only on unseen reviews). Multi-turn so the vague request doesn't stall. Harness note: if the build dedups via workflow static data (removeItemsSeenInPreviousExecutions) rather than a seedable Data Table read, the in-harness run starts with empty static data so the 'only new' count can't be exercised and the scenario reds — a harness limitation, not a build defect; build correctness is carried by outcomeExpectations.
outcomeExpectations: The workflow runs on a recurring schedule (a Schedule Trigger) to poll for reviews.
It fetches reviews from both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.
It distinguishes new/unseen reviews from ones already processed (e.g. by comparing against stored state) so only new reviews trigger a notification.
A push/notification is sent to the user for new reviews.
